description: Email/password registration and sign-in work end-to-end through the Connect API, with input validation and faithful error relay that does not leak account existence.

requirements.description: Implement end-to-end email/password registration and sign-in through the Connect RPC API. Input validation must be thorough (email format, password strength policy). Error responses must faithfully relay backend errors without leaking account existence (no enumeration: same error shape for unknown email vs wrong password). Registration must reject duplicate emails with a non-enumerating response.
requirements.title: Email/Password Registration and Sign-In via Connect API

validation.notes: api/internal/auth/validation_test.go: verify email format and password-strength rules reject malformed inputs and return structured errors
api/internal/auth/validation_test.go: verify error messages for unknown-email and wrong-password paths are indistinguishable (same code, same message shape)
api/internal/auth/registration_test.go: verify duplicate-email registration returns a non-enumerating error identical in shape to a generic failure
api/handlers/auth/register_e2e_test.go: POST register with valid credentials → 200 + account created in SQLite; re-register same email → error that does not reveal existence
api/handlers/auth/signin_e2e_test.go: sign-in with correct credentials → access token + refresh token issued; wrong password → generic error; unknown email → same generic error shape
api/handlers/auth/signin_e2e_test.go: connect RPC surface returns Connect-typed errors, not raw HTTP error strings
bas/auth/registration_flow_test: user can complete registration form, submit, and receive confirmation without server errors
bas/auth/signin_flow_test: user can sign in with registered credentials and reach authenticated state

title: Account Authentication
